nodes.description: Constant DECIMALS = 1e18 used as the base precision for conversion rates in ChainlinkConversionPath.
Public nested mapping allAggregators[input][output] => aggregator address, storing the Chainlink aggregator used for each currency pair.
Roles.Role private _whitelistAdmins storing the set of whitelist administrators.
Public address paymentProxy, target of the delegatecall performing the actual token transfer.
Public ChainlinkConversionPath instance used to compute the conversion rate and rate timestamp.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): performs a + b and reverts on overflow via require(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256): forwards to the message-carrying sub overload.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string): requires b <= a then computes a - b.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): returns 0 for a == 0, otherwise a * b with overflow require.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256): forwards to the message-carrying div overload.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256,string): requires b > 0 then computes a / b.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256): forwards to the message-carrying mod overload.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256,string): requires b != 0 then computes a % b.
Roles.add(Role storage, address): grants a role to an account after zero-address and duplicate checks.
Roles.remove(Role storage, address): revokes a role from an account after zero-address and membership checks.
Roles.has(Role storage, address): view function returning whether the account holds the role.
WhitelistAdminRole constructor that grants the whitelist admin role to msg.sender (the deployer).
Modifier onlyWhitelistAdmin that requires isWhitelistAdmin(msg.sender) before executing the guarded function body.
Public view isWhitelistAdmin(address): returns whether the account is a whitelist admin via Roles.has.
Public addWhitelistAdmin(address) gated by onlyWhitelistAdmin; delegates the actual grant to _addWhitelistAdmin.
Public renounceWhitelistAdmin() that removes msg.sender from the whitelist admin role.
Internal _addWhitelistAdmin(address): calls Roles.add and emits WhitelistAdminAdded.
Internal _removeWhitelistAdmin(address): calls Roles.remove and emits WhitelistAdminRemoved.
External updateAggregator(address,address,address) gated by onlyWhitelistAdmin; writes allAggregators and emits AggregatorUpdated.
External updateAggregatorsList(address[],address[],address[]) gated by onlyWhitelistAdmin; batch-updates allAggregators with length checks.
External view getConversion(uint256,address[]): calls getRate and computes the converted amount as amountIn * rate / decimals.
Public view getRate(address[]): iterates the path, queries Chainlink aggregators and composes the rate and oldest timestamp.
Private view getAggregatorAndDecimals(address,address): resolves the aggregator (direct or reverse) and the two currency decimals.
Private view getDecimals(address): returns 18 for ETH, ERC20 decimals() for contracts, 8 for FIAT.
Private view isContract(address): uses inline assembly extcodesize to detect a contract.
ERC20ConversionProxy constructor setting paymentProxy and chainlinkConversionPath from constructor arguments.
External transferFromWithReferenceAndFee(...) that computes conversions, enforces _maxToSpend and delegatecalls the payment proxy.
Internal getConversions(...): fetches the rate from ChainlinkConversionPath, enforces _maxRateTimespan and computes the payment and fee amounts.
msg.sender as attacker-controllable caller, used for admin role checks, role renouncement and the deployer role grant.
block.timestamp used as a time source for rate staleness and for the _maxRateTimespan freshness check.
Low-level delegatecall into the paymentProxy with an ABI-encoded selector constructed from a calldata-derived path.
Inline assembly block reading extcodesize of an arbitrary address to determine if it holds a contract.
External calls to aggregator.latestAnswer(), latestTimestamp() and decimals() on an address taken from the allAggregators mapping.
Raw arithmetic operators (+,-,*,/,%) inside the SafeMath library guarded only by require statements.
Storage writes into the allAggregators mapping by privileged administrators, changing the aggregator used for conversions.
Function parameter _input: input currency address of updateAggregator.
Function parameter _output: output currency address of updateAggregator.
Function parameter _aggregator: aggregator contract address stored in allAggregators.
Function parameter _amountIn: amount to convert in getConversion.
Function parameter _path: array of currency addresses describing the conversion path.
Function parameter _to: transfer recipient of transferFromWithReferenceAndFee.
Function parameter _requestAmount: requested amount in the request currency.
Function parameter _feeAmount: fee amount requested in the request currency.
Function parameter _feeAddress: fee recipient address forwarded to the payment proxy.
Function parameter _maxToSpend: upper bound on the total amount spent on behalf of the user.
Function parameter _maxRateTimespan: maximum accepted age of the oldest rate, zero disables the check.
Function parameter account: address granted or checked for the whitelist admin role.
Function parameter _addr: address whose decimals / contract status is queried.
Local variable rate: accumulated conversion rate in getRate, initialized to DECIMALS.
Local variable currentRate: rate read from aggregator.latestAnswer() for the current path hop.
Local variable currentTimestamp: aggregator timestamp used to track the oldest rate timestamp.
Local variable amountToPay: converted request amount computed in getConversions.
Local variable amountToPayInFees: converted fee amount computed in getConversions.
Local variable status: boolean success flag returned by the delegatecall to the payment proxy.

edges.reason: onlyWhitelistAdmin evaluates isWhitelistAdmin(msg.sender), tying the caller identity to the authorization decision.
updateAggregator is guarded by the onlyWhitelistAdmin modifier.
updateAggregatorsList is guarded by the onlyWhitelistAdmin modifier.
addWhitelistAdmin is guarded by the onlyWhitelistAdmin modifier.
The constructor grants the whitelist admin role to msg.sender (deployer).
renounceWhitelistAdmin removes msg.sender from the whitelist admin role.
isWhitelistAdmin is queried with msg.sender inside the onlyWhitelistAdmin modifier.
getRate initializes oldestRateTimestamp with block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable time source.
getConversions compares block.timestamp against oldestTimestampRate to enforce _maxRateTimespan.
transferFromWithReferenceAndFee delegatecalls into paymentProxy, an external address able to execute arbitrary code before state finalization.
The delegatecall target can re-enter the proxy contract during the transfer.
getConversion calls getRate to obtain rate, timestamp and decimals.
getRate calls getAggregatorAndDecimals for each hop of the path.
getAggregatorAndDecimals calls getDecimals for the input and output currencies.
getDecimals calls isContract to decide whether to read ERC20 decimals.
transferFromWithReferenceAndFee calls getConversions to compute the payable amounts.
getConversions calls chainlinkConversionPath.getRate with the conversion path.
The WhitelistAdminRole constructor calls _addWhitelistAdmin for msg.sender.
addWhitelistAdmin delegates the grant to _addWhitelistAdmin.
renounceWhitelistAdmin delegates the revocation to _removeWhitelistAdmin.
_addWhitelistAdmin calls Roles.add to set the bearer flag.
_removeWhitelistAdmin calls Roles.remove to clear the bearer flag.
isWhitelistAdmin calls Roles.has on the _whitelistAdmins role.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) forwards to the overload carrying an error message.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) forwards to the overload carrying an error message.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256) forwards to the overload carrying an error message.
updateAggregator writes the allAggregators storage mapping for the input/output pair.
updateAggregatorsList writes multiple entries of the allAggregators storage mapping in a loop.
SafeMath.add executes the raw a + b operator guarded only by require(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub executes the raw a - b operator guarded only by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul executes the raw a * b operator guarded only by require(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div executes the raw a / b operator guarded only by require(b > 0).
SafeMath.mod executes the raw a % b operator guarded only by require(b != 0).
getRate reads latestTimestamp, latestAnswer and decimals from an externally registered aggregator contract.
isContract relies on an inline assembly extcodesize read of an arbitrary address.
_input is used as the first mapping key written by updateAggregator.
_output is used as the second mapping key written by updateAggregator.
_aggregator is the value stored in allAggregators by updateAggregator.
_amountIn feeds the multiplication with the rate inside getConversion.
_path is forwarded to getRate by getConversion.
_to is forwarded into the delegatecall payload as the transfer recipient.
_requestAmount is passed to getConversions and emitted in the event.
_feeAmount is passed to getConversions and emitted in the event.
_feeAddress is forwarded into the delegatecall payload as the fee recipient.
_maxToSpend bounds the sum of the computed payment and fees.
_maxRateTimespan is forwarded to getConversions and emitted in the event.
account is the address granted the whitelist admin role by addWhitelistAdmin.
_addr determines whether ETH, an ERC20 decimals call, or the FIAT default is used.
rate accumulates the composed conversion rate inside getRate.
currentRate holds the per-hop aggregator answer used to update rate.
currentTimestamp is compared against oldestRateTimestamp inside getRate.
amountToPay is computed and returned by getConversions.
amountToPayInFees is computed and returned by getConversions.
status is the success flag checked by require after the delegatecall.
_path is forwarded from transferFromWithReferenceAndFee into getConversions.
_requestAmount is converted into amountToPay inside getConversions.
_feeAmount is converted into amountToPayInFees inside getConversions.
_maxRateTimespan is compared with the rate age inside getConversions.
